name: Samchully Co.,Ltd
summary: Samchully Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, supplies city gas and district energy in South Korea. The company also generates and sells electricity; develops and operates renewable energy projects; provides engineering, construction, maintenance, and energy services; sells and services automobiles; and operates hospitality, food service, and investment businesses. The company was formerly known as Samchully Industry Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Samchully Co.,Ltd. in October 1984. Samchully Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
